label: What was R's first religious preference

questions.text:
I'd like to go over your religious preferences since you were raised as a (RELIGION AND/OR DENOMINATION MENTIONED IN RELIG16/ DENOM16).

Yes................(ASK A) 
No..............(GO TO MARELIG)
